title: 第7章 一手捏爆太一道宫无法消止的杀戮第8章 贱婢你罪该万死内讧相互指责
slug: 被问罪当天无上帝族杀来
content_zh:
只见陈无敌探出的手，顷刻间化作一记龙爪，天雷在上面缠绕，无尽神威在上面肆虐着。
从中可以看到一重重神韵在叠加，不断闪动着惊世异象。
在龙爪成型的一瞬，天地齐皆是震动不止，天道秩律在龙力的逼压下，一点点地崩溃。
很快，探出的龙爪将整个太一道宫笼罩，所有的气机在这一刻尽数被锁绝。
什么叫天塌了，这一刻就是。
这时，太一道宫老祖再也忍不住了，从祖地中急冲而起。
当看着半空中悬探着的龙爪时，他整个人都麻了。
刹时间，无尽的恐惧化作电流，从他头顶流至脚底，全身骤然冰凉一片。
我们太一道宫这是犯了天条了吗？
有没有人告诉我！！！
这到底发生了什么。
这时这刻，秦伏天凌乱了，整个人如同大海的一叶扁舟一样，无助又震恐。
他不过是闭关修炼一段时间而已，这他妈太一道宫都要没了。
这绝望又无辜的感觉，家人们谁懂啊！
唰唰唰！
这时，太一道宫的宫主和长老，一一从底下冲出来。
相较于秦伏天的还算镇定，秦潜龙这些人都差点没被吓尿。
他们活了这么久，何时见到如此大阵仗。
“你们谁干的好事。”秦伏天转身吼道，整个人有些竭斯底里。
“不是我。”

“我什么也不知道，刚不久才闭关出来。”
“我睡自家女弟子，这事算吗？”
“我睡自家男弟子，这事应该也不算吧。”
“我虽也习有双修之术，但平时都是和灵兽玩玩而已，这应该不算得罪人吧。”
“……”
听着底下长老的自爆，秦伏天顿时气不打一处来。
你听听，这是人干的事。
我太一道宫也算是名门正派了，怎么会出了这么一些东西。
我他妈的。
越想，秦伏天越有杀人的冲动。
但愤怒归愤怒，有些事还是要解决的。
正在他要向陈无敌求饶之际，一道声音突然响起，“陈贤侄，此事只是秦牧与罗浩个人所为，你把凶手严惩则可。”
“至于太一道宫，完全不知情，不如就放它一马如何？”
秦伏天等人顿时明白了，原来是秦牧做的好事。
陈无敌瞳孔中血雷炸荡，引天万丈天雷：“你什么东西，也配来阻我。”
“我……”姜太初又气又怒。
他说什么也是界护殿殿主，什么时候被如此辱骂了。
“闭嘴，再多说一句话，我连你界护殿也灭了。”陈无敌沉声一吼。
“狂妄！”姜太初顿时震怒了。
天命帝族，他确实招惹不起。
content_en:
I saw Chen Wudi's stretched out hand, which instantly turned into a dragon's claw, with sky thunder entangled on it, and endless divine power raging on it.
From it, you can see multiple layers of charm being superimposed, constantly flashing shocking visions.
At the moment when the dragon's claw was formed, the whole world was shaking, and the order of heaven collapsed bit by bit under the pressure of the dragon's power.
Soon, the protruding dragon claws enveloped the entire Taiyi Palace, and all the energy was locked at this moment.
What does it mean that the sky is falling? This is the moment.
At this time, the ancestor of Taiyi Palace couldn't bear it anymore and rushed up from the ancestral ground.
When he looked at the dragon claw hanging in mid-air, his whole body went numb.
In an instant, the endless fear turned into electric current, flowing from the top of his head to the soles of his feet, and his whole body suddenly became cold.
Is our Taiyi Palace violating the rules of heaven?
Does anyone tell me! ! !
What the hell is going on.
At this moment, Qin Futian was in a mess. He was like a boat in the sea, helpless and frightened.
He just practiced in seclusion for a period of time, and this damn palace is going to be gone.
Who in the family understands this desperate and innocent feeling?
Swish, swish, swish!
At this time, the palace owners and elders of Taiyi Palace rushed out from underneath one by one.
Compared with Qin Futian who was relatively calm, Qin Qianlong and others were almost scared to death.
They have lived for so long, how could they ever see such a big battle?
"Which of you did something good?" Qin Futian turned around and shouted, feeling a little hysterical.
"Not me."
"I don't know anything. I just came out of seclusion not long ago."
"I slept with my female disciple, does this matter?"
"I slept with my male disciple, so this shouldn't be considered a problem."
"Although I am also accustomed to the art of dual cultivation, I usually just play with spirit beasts. This shouldn't offend anyone."
"..."
Hearing the self-destruction of the elder below, Qin Futian suddenly became furious.
Listen, this is what people do.
My Taiyi Palace is from a well-known and upright family, how could I come up with such things?
Fuck me.
The more he thought about it, the more Qin Futian had the urge to kill.
But anger is anger, and some things still need to be resolved.
Just as he was about to beg for mercy from Chen Wudi, a voice suddenly sounded, "Nephew Chen, this matter was only the fault of Qin Mu and Luo Hao. You can punish the murderer severely."
"As for Taiyi Palace, I don't know about it at all. How about letting it go?"
Qin Futian and others immediately understood that it was Qin Mu who had done something good.
Chen Wudi's pupils exploded with blood and thunder, causing thousands of thunders to hit the sky: "You are not worthy of stopping me."
"I..." Jiang Taichu was angry and angry.
He said that he was also the master of the Jiehu Palace. When had he been insulted like this?
"Shut up, if you say one more word, I will destroy your Jiehudian too." Chen Wudi roared in a deep voice.
"Arrogant!" Jiang Taichu was immediately furious.
He really couldn't afford to offend the Tianming Imperial Clan.
